claimDetails.heading: Scope and method
claimDetails.claim: This book asks how positive composition, typed carriers, transformation, dynamics and observation can be held in one research architecture without being declared identical. It begins from ordinary measuring ideas, states each mathematical object and then follows only the bridges for which a map or explicit test is available.

claimDetails.heading: Scope and method
claimDetails.claim: The labels established, conditional, obstruction and open are part of the result. A beautiful chain of mathematics is not converted into a physical theory by typography or narrative momentum.

claimDetails.heading: The authority boundary
claimDetails.claim: This volume reports calculations and constructions internal to declared models. It is not empirical confirmation, peer review, or a derivation of the Standard Model. Every strong sentence carries a nearby statement of what it does not establish.

claimDetails.heading: A book of layers
claimDetails.claim: A ruler can tell you the length of a table without telling you why the table exists. A compass can preserve a direction without choosing which direction should count as north. Much of this programme has the same layered character. It contains exact measuring structures, conditional mechanisms and proposed physical interpretations. The reader should not flatten those layers into one claim.

claimDetails.heading: A book of layers
claimDetails.claim: Each chapter therefore moves in the same order: ordinary picture, defined object, exact result, and authority boundary. A term such as symplectic is introduced only after the familiar idea it formalizes: preserving oriented area in a phase-space plane. A term such as chirality is introduced only after the familiar idea: left- and right-handed patterns cannot always be superposed by rotation.

claimDetails.heading: Four labels used throughout
claimDetails.claim: Established means that a calculation follows from its written assumptions and has an executable or inspectable certificate. Conditional means that a construction works after a named field, coefficient, boundary condition or control is supplied. Externally open means that the missing ingredient is not contained in the current corpus. Internally exhausted means that further rearrangement of the same ingredients no longer addresses the missing datum.

claimDetails.heading: Four labels used throughout
claimDetails.claim: None of these labels means true of nature. Even an exact theorem can describe the wrong physical system. Conversely, a blocked physical programme can contain useful mathematics, simulation tools and experimentally transferable methods.

claimDetails.heading: The route through the book
claimDetails.claim: The admissibility frontier comes first because it identifies the changed route to discovery: recover distinctions that ordinary measurements erase, then trace their admission, dynamics and detection. The following chapters build one exact Jordan-to-Lie rank-two hinge from response measurements and relational loops before asking whether it can carry Standard-Model matter, safe interactions or exceptional structure. The result ledger records positive findings and reversals; the research frontier ends in controlled experiments and explicit reopening conditions rather than in a larger symmetry slogan.

claimDetails.heading: Things before names
claimDetails.claim: Begin with the preparation, response table, path, boundary, update or detector record before introducing the algebraic name that compresses it. Show what can be done to the thing and what remains unchanged. Technical language then becomes earned precision rather than an entrance fee.

claimDetails.heading: Things before names
claimDetails.claim: For example, two coupled readouts and their nonnegative response come before H₂(ℝ); eliminating a hidden component comes before the Schur complement and Jordan triple; transport around a loop and a changed return come before holonomy.

claimDetails.heading: Every bridge carries a reason
claimDetails.claim: Two technical nouns placed beside one another do not explain their relationship. Every material bridge must say why the things are alike, why they differ, what produces the difference, whether its mathematical and physical parts are open or closed, what follows, what does not follow and which calculation or observation would decide the remainder.

claimDetails.heading: Every bridge carries a reason
claimDetails.claim: The compact grammar is because—but—therefore—still open. An unlabeled arrow, shared name, repeated number or similar diagram is a prompt to investigate, not a completed bridge.

claimDetails.heading: Pictures and speculation are optional
claimDetails.claim: Landscape, grammar, network, workshop, ecological, mythic and theological pictures may be offered after the reason-bearing core. They form a menu, not a ladder of belief: a reader may use the theorem or experiment while rejecting every optional interpretation.

claimDetails.heading: Pictures and speculation are optional
claimDetails.claim: A picture must pass deletion and substitution tests. Removing it or replacing it with another picture must leave the typed objects, reason, status, implication and test unchanged; otherwise it carries a hidden premise.

claimDetails.heading: The shift
claimDetails.claim: The next route to new physics may begin not with higher energy but with greater finesse: preserving phase, delay, boundary order, memory, orientation and cross-channel relation that ordinary measurements average away. The programme therefore begins where candidate mechanisms become observationally equivalent and asks which erased distinction would separate them.

claimDetails.heading: The shift
claimDetails.claim: This is a change of protagonist. Spin₀(2,3) and the larger symmetry landscape no longer lead the story. The admission–dynamics–detection loop does, because it determines which mathematical differences can become physical records.

claimDetails.heading: Why Jordan and Lie must be balanced
claimDetails.claim: Jordan structure delimits what can coexist and compose as positive states, responses and observables. Lie structure describes how those admitted objects transform and circulate. Jordan has explanatory priority; Lie has dynamical necessity; neither can supply the carrier, selector and detector alone.

claimDetails.heading: Why Jordan and Lie must be balanced
claimDetails.claim: Spin₀(2,3) is an exact conformal completion of one declared rank-two Jordan response cone. It is therefore a recovered symmetry of an admitted geometry, not the prior container of physics.

claimDetails.heading: Dynamics moves the boundary
claimDetails.claim: Bound states, boundary bands, resonances and free continua are joined by spectral flow, capture, decay and memory. Dynamics is tested by what it preserves, which context selects a history and which record survives finite detection—not only by whether an equation of motion can be written.

claimDetails.heading: Dynamics moves the boundary
claimDetails.claim: This turns Casimir response, thermoelectric transport, holonomy, hysteresis, metastability and scattering delay into complementary probes of a changing admissibility boundary.

claimDetails.heading: The third term is the mediator
claimDetails.claim: A boundary, selector, environment, memory kernel or detector orientation can mediate the relation between nominal endpoints. Ternary structure makes this context-dependence explicit: changing the middle term can change the admissible relation without changing the endpoints.

claimDetails.heading: The third term is the mediator
claimDetails.claim: The scientific question behind retained identity or ‘soul’ is whether a measurable invariant survives transformation, descent and observation. This does not declare a soul to be a field or particle.

claimDetails.heading: The finesse technology pathway
claimDetails.claim: The practical sequence is to find a mechanism collision, identify the erased distinction, build a detector or reversal that retains it and replicate any residual on an independent carrier. Phase-sensitive controls, nonlinear correlators, boundary-order probes, memory-aware inference and same-material response closure are the immediate tools.

claimDetails.heading: The finesse technology pathway
claimDetails.claim: Each experiment has two valuable outcomes: improved theory or technology if established physics closes the record, and a disciplined anomaly path if a preregistered residual survives nuisance models, reversals and cross-carrier replication. Only the latter sequence can promote the result toward new physics.

findings.statement: With the declared normalization, a compact charge-three Abelian Higgs sector reduces in the strict infrared to level-three BF theory. A gapped unit-charge reader may retain sector memory without becoming a topological degree of freedom.

findings.statement: After replacing the incorrect A-bar-B invariant by AB and common-phase symmetry by opposite-phase U(1), the two-branch flow closes on an SO(2,1) cone and is reproduced exactly by a two-mode squeezing Hamiltonian with completely positive loss.
